evidence.s1_ci: ci.yml runs on `pull_request` only, with `contents: read`, and runs `npm ci`, `npm test` (whose pretest runs prepare-data) and `npm run build` (svelte-check plus vite build) in site/. All of these scripts exist in site/package.json. pages.yml deploys on `push: branches: [main]`. release.yml runs only on `v*` tags, sets `contents: write` per job and uses only `github.token`. pr-title.yml uses `permissions: {}` and passes the title through env to avoid script injection. There is no `pull_request_target` and nothing was pushed or deployed. However, every action is pinned to a moving major tag, not a full commit SHA: `actions/checkout@v7`, `actions/setup-node@v7`, `actions/configure-pages@v6`, `actions/upload-pages-artifact@v5`, `actions/deploy-pages@v5` (step1.patch lines 86, 88, 148, 165, 179, 239, 243). pages.yml also grants `pages: write` and `id-token: write` to the whole workflow, so the build job that runs `npm ci` and the tests gets them too, when only `deploy` needs them. And `workflow_dispatch` lets the deploy start from any branch, not only main.
evidence.s1_readme: README.md (step1.patch lines 484-602) covers what is in the repository, Install (`cd site`, `npm ci`, Node 22 from .nvmrc), Develop (`npm run dev` and the other scripts in a table), Test (`npm test`), Build (`npm run build`, `npm run preview`, PAGES_BASE), CI, Contribute (pointing to CONTRIBUTING.md, which has a full data-change section), versions and the MIT licence. Every npm script it names exists in app/site/package.json (dev, index, fieldsets, prepare-data, sample-bullets, test, build, preview). Every file it links exists in app/: LICENSE, THIRD-PARTY.md, data/bullets/README.md, site/UI.md, .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/*.
evidence.s1_release: The strategy is consistent across files. docs/releasing.md says SemVer, with the version kept only in `site/package.json` (0.1.0). A release is a `vX.Y.Z` tag on main, and release.yml enforces this: it checks the tag against package.json, checks that the commit is on origin/main, and checks for a `## [X.Y.Z] - ` changelog section, whose text it then uses as the release notes. The release steps are written out (`npm version --no-git-tag-version`, rename Unreleased, `chore(release)` commit, tag). CHANGELOG.md states Keep a Changelog 1.1.0 and the heading format. dependabot.yml covers npm (/site) and github-actions, with commit prefixes that match the convention. CONTRIBUTING.md states Conventional Commits with a type table, and all 7 commits in commits.txt follow it (ci:, build(deps):, docs:, feat(site):, fix(site):). Two small points: adding the Dependabot config is typed `build(deps)`, which reads like a dependency bump, and releasing.md links docs/agents/triage-labels.md, which is not in app/.
evidence.s2_requirements: Every requirement is met. Route: router.ts parses `compare/<a>/<b>` (splitting before decoding) and App.svelte renders Compare.svelte for it, so a hash route survives a reload. Drawing: overlayOf takes `caseOuterProfile(adaptMetallic(..))` for both cases and puts them in one `viewportFor([first, second], {scale:1})`, so they share one scale and one axis, with z=0 at the same x. Each outline is a single `<path>`, the SVG has `role="img"` and its `aria-label` comes from `compare.profiles` with `first.name` and `second.name`, and shot cartridges are excluded. Table: dimensionsOf reads only `record.cartridge`, keeps only numbers, skips fields ending in `Tol` and fields in FIELD_UNITS, labels with FIELD_LABELS, and has a caption of Dimensions (mm) or (in). The headers are Symbol, name A, name B, Difference, and difference(a, b) is b − a. Units: showLength uses formatValue for metric and displayNumber(value, 'in') for imperial, following unitSystem(). The detail page has a `Label` 'Compare with' with a NativeSelect of the other entries sorted by name and a 'Compare' button. German strings are added. There is a changelog entry and a feat commit.
evidence.s2_correctness: The values match the data: the test checks e min 1.4/0.94/−0.46 and E1 10.39/12.07/1.68, which agree with 308_win.json and 300_win_mag.json. difference() removes floating-point noise without dropping real precision. The imperial conversion uses the site's displayNumber. Shot cartridges and records too thin to draw get a message, and an unknown key ends in the catch branch. One defect: the head-face guide line in compare.ts is `head: [headX, topY, headX, centreY + view.rMax]`, where `topY = view.xy(view.rMax, 0)[1]`, which already equals `centreY + rMax`. The line therefore has zero length and is never drawn. The test checks only `head[0]`, so it misses this. The outlines themselves are correct.
evidence.s2_fit: The feature reuses `caseOuterProfile`/`adaptMetallic` (shapes2d), `viewportFor`/`fullSectionPath`/`fmt` (geom), `FIELD_LABELS`/`FIELD_UNITS`/`orderedFields`/`GROUP_ORDER`/`formatValue` (core), `displayNumber` and `unitSystem`, and the site's PageHeader, ScaleRuler, Label, NativeSelect and Button components. It follows the route-chunk, metadata, nav and i18n patterns and puts its styles in `@layer legacy`, as GroupTable does. One duplication: dimensionsOf (compare.ts) re-implements the group ordering of `orderedGroups` in site/src/lib/fields.ts (the GROUP_ORDER filter, then the rest sorted) instead of calling it. The CONTRIBUTING.md wording tweak is unneeded but harmless.
evidence.s2_tests: compare.test.ts tests difference (floating-point noise, negative values, zero), the dimension filtering against real 308 Win./300 Win. Mag. records (tolerances, pressures, angles, chamber fields and lists excluded; zero kept; order), showLength in metric and imperial, and the overlay geometry: 1 mm per unit, a common axis, head faces at the same x, and the shot and thin-record cases. router.test.ts adds round-trip and malformed-URL cases. These are Vitest tests in site/src/lib like the existing ones. Not covered: the SVG accessible name, the table headers and caption, and the Cartridge-page select and button. The repo has no component-test setup, which limits this. The test also misses the zero-length head line.
evidence.s3_fixes: Bug: allDimensions (step3.patch compare.ts) now takes the union of both records' symbols and slots each B-only symbol after its predecessor. A cell is null where a record does not publish the dimension, and so is the difference, and Compare.svelte renders those as ''. The tests check that `delta L` (a: 0.1, b: null) and `R3` (a: null, b: 13.51) now appear, and cover the ordering and disjoint cases. Style: no change was needed. Compare.svelte already had `th, td { text-align: right }` with `th:first-child, td:first-child { text-align: left }` in `@layer legacy` since step 2 (step2.patch lines 727-730), so the cartridge and Difference columns and their headers are already right-aligned, as GroupTable's are. The only other edits are copy that described 'dimensions both publish' (the lede, compare.none) and the changelog line, all following from the fix.
evidence.cross_step: Step 2 adds a line under `[Unreleased]` → `### Added`, and step 3 edits that same unreleased line, which is right for a change to an unreleased feature. Neither bumps site/package.json, which matches the stated strategy of bumping only at release time. The commits `feat(site): add a view that compares two cartridges` and `fix(site): list dimensions that only one compared cartridge publishes` follow the stated convention and the pr-title regex. The code is typed consistently (DimensionRow made nullable, callers updated) and the tests are written for Vitest, so the `npm test` and `npm run build` checks should pass. I did not run them.

unmet_requirements: Step 1 / CI: actions are pinned to major tags (`@v7`, `@v6`, `@v5`), not full commit SHAs
Step 1 / CI: pages.yml grants `pages: write` and `id-token: write` to the whole workflow, including the build job, so permissions are not least-privilege
strengths: The compare view meets every step 2 requirement as written. It reuses caseOuterProfile, viewportFor/fullSectionPath, FIELD_LABELS/FIELD_UNITS/formatValue and displayNumber, and adds careful handling of floating-point differences.

Step 1 sets up a coherent release process: the version lives only in site/package.json, a tag-triggered release checks the tag, the main branch and the changelog section, the changelog states Keep a Changelog, Dependabot uses conventional prefixes, and a pr-title check enforces the commit convention. All commits follow that convention.
The step 3 bug fix is clean (allDimensions, with nulls and an ordering that slots B-only symbols in place), comes with tests for the named `delta L`/`R3` cases, and keeps the changelog current.
issues: None of the actions in any workflow is pinned to a full commit SHA. Every `uses:` line points to a moving major tag (`actions/checkout@v7`, etc.) in a repository that accepts outside pull requests.

pages.yml grants `pages: write` and `id-token: write` at the workflow level, so the build job that runs `npm ci` and the tests holds them too. `workflow_dispatch` also lets someone start a deploy from a branch other than main.

In compare.ts the head-face guide line runs from (headX, centreY+rMax) to the same point, so it has zero length and is never drawn. compare.ts also re-implements `orderedGroups` from site/src/lib/fields.ts instead of reusing it.
review.verdict: The feature and the review fix are correct, well tested and in keeping with the repository, and the release, changelog and commit conventions set up in step 1 are applied consistently in later steps. The main thing blocking a merge is the CI hardening: the actions are not pinned to commit SHAs and the Pages workflow grants more permissions than needed, with a small drawing bug (the head-face guide line has zero length) worth fixing too.
